versions.changelog: Activity log on the user page (what was sent to IMDb, what failed and why) and live progress while a sync is running.
Support browser cookies (at-main=Atza|...): the cookie is now sent the way the IMDb website does it instead of the Android app token header.

name: IMDb Sync
description: Marks movies and episodes as watched on IMDb as soon as a user finishes them in Jellyfin, plus a daily catch-up task. Every user connects their own IMDb account by pasting their IMDb cookie on a self-service page.
overview: Sync each user's Jellyfin watch history to their own IMDb account
